lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Commander,

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: do you have a moment?
Yes, I do.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: I heard that you've been having trouble sleeping.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Is there something that is concerning you?
I've been binge watching a lot of TV series.
It's because this new game just released.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Yes, I believe Signa told me you and her

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: are doing something like that.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Yes, I believe Maiden told me

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: you two recently joined the same guild.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: If that's the case, I'm glad.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: I thought it might have been something

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: that you weren't able to tell us.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: I was worried.
Thank you for your concern.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Commander,

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: if there is anything weighing heavy on your mind,

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: you would share it with us, wouldn't you?
I don't want to put any more of burden on any of you.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Commander.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: We're on your side.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: More than you might think.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: I can't guarantee how much help we'll be...

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: But I believe we're stronger together than apart.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: I think it's better to put our minds together to solve any problems we're up against.
I'll do that next time.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Of course, I'm not saying you have to tell us everything.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Just know that we are always by your side.
Okay.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Thank you, Commander.

lines.speaker: rapi
lines.text: Get some rest.
